ideas.title: Smash Hail for Eggs
ideas.hook: Hailstorms hit your plot every few minutes. Smash the giant hailstones before they melt and crack out the egg frozen inside.
core_loop: Wait for the storm siren
Smash falling hailstones with your hammer
Grab the egg inside before it melts away
Hatch pets that hit harder and attract bigger storms
ideas.twist: Bigger storms drop rarer hail but also knock you around, so you pick how much storm you can handle.
retention: Offline hail pile to smash on return
ideas.why_now: Break × Disaster is a top open gap (6.17). Break / mine / dig is the fastest mechanic at 3.17x (Break and Steal an Egg 184.1K CCU, Drill for Eggs 9.8K), Disaster / weather is up 1.25x ([🌋] Swim For Eggs! 12.5K) and "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.49x.
ideas.differentiator: Egg breakers give you a fixed rock; here the weather delivers the eggs and you race the melt.

ideas.title: Toss Hats for Drip
ideas.hook: Fling hats across a runway onto passing models. Land a clean ring-toss and you win that look for your wardrobe.
core_loop: Pick a hat from your rack
Charge the throw meter and fling it
Land it on a moving model's head for points
Unlock rarer hats and longer runways
ideas.twist: Each model has a style tag; matching the hat to the tag pays triple and unlocks the outfit.
retention: Daily model with a secret style
ideas.why_now: Hit × Fashion is an open gap (4.38). Hit / swing / launch is up 1.69x (+1 Stone Skipping 34.5K CCU, Ragdoll Engine 7.9K) and Fashion / beauty is up 1.57x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 17.9K, Makeup Frenzy 5.4K).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are menus and voting; this one is a skill toss where aim earns the outfit.

ideas.title: +1 Mech Height
ideas.hook: Every step your mech takes makes it 1 stud taller. Get tall enough to step over the walls into bigger worlds.
core_loop: Walk your mech around the zone
Gain +1 height per step
Step over the next wall into a new world
Rebirth for a stronger mech chassis
ideas.twist: Tall mechs move slowly, so you swap between height and speed builds to clear each wall.
ideas.why_now: +1 × Robots is an open gap (3.54). "+1 ___" titles are up 1.83x and +1 stat per action 1.70x (+1 Stone Skipping 34.5K CCU, +1 Karate Evolution 13.0K, +1 Assassin Leveling 12.4K). Robots / mechs is up 1.50x (Kit PVP! 2.3K). Hub + zones maps are up 1.83x.
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games grow the player; here the walls between zones are the goal and size is the key.

ideas.title: Swing for Survivors
ideas.hook: Zombies swarm your rooftop base each night. Bat them off the edge for distance, and rescue the survivors hiding in the streets below.
core_loop: Defend the roof with your bat at night
Launch zombies for distance coins
Send rescued survivors to build roof upgrades by day
Unlock bigger bats and taller rooftops
ideas.twist: Each survivor you save has a job (cook, builder, sniper) that adds a new part to your base.
ideas.why_now: Hit × Zombies is an open gap (3.37). Hit / swing / launch is up 1.69x (+1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs 9.7K CCU) and Zombies are up 1.20x (Build and Kill Zombies 10.4K, Zombie Air Force 4.3K). Survive + Tycoon pairs already pull 48.8K young CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie base games use turrets; here a bat and launch physics are the defence.

ideas.title: Paint Frost for Coins
ideas.hook: Paint frost art on the windows of a frozen mansion. Visitors pay to see the best rooms, but every heat wave melts your work.
core_loop: Pick a window and frost brush
Paint a pattern on the glass
Visitors rate the room and pay coins
Buy bigger windows and new frost colours
ideas.twist: Heat waves roll through each hour; rooms with better insulation keep their art and keep earning.
ideas.why_now: Paint × Ice / fire is an open gap (5.23). Paint / create is up 2.02x (Paint to Get Rich 22.3K CCU, Paint a Pancake 8.9K), Ice / fire / elements is up 1.65x (Melt All The Ice! 3.5K) and interior maps are the fastest map style at 1.94x.
ideas.differentiator: Paint games keep the picture forever; here the art melts, so players keep coming back to repaint.

ideas.title: Sell Lava Lamps
ideas.hook: Mix glowing lava colours into lamps in your back room, then sell them in your shop. Rare colour blends sell for a fortune.
core_loop: Mix wax colours in the back room
Heat the lamp until it flows
Put it on the shelf for customers
Buy new wax colours and bigger shelves
ideas.twist: Some blends glitter or glow in the dark, and collectors pay huge for the first lamp of a new blend.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is up 1.51x (Sell Fries! 48.6K CCU, Create Pottery 2.4K), Ice / fire / elements 1.65x (Firefighting Sim 13.8K) and Paint / create 2.02x. Interior maps are up 1.94x, led by Sell Fries! at 48.6K.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell fixed goods; here you invent each product by mixing colours.

ideas.title: Roll Boulders for Gold
ideas.hook: Race giant boulders down a mountain against other players. Your boulder picks up stones and grows as it rolls; first to the bottom wins gold.
core_loop: Pick your boulder at the summit
Roll down the course, gaining +1 size per stone
Knock rivals off the track
Spend gold on new boulders and courses
ideas.twist: Bigger boulders smash through walls but turn slowly, so you choose your size on each course.
ideas.why_now: Stones / rocks / ores is the fastest theme at 2.66x (+1 Stone Skipping 34.5K CCU, Lift Rock For Eggs 17.7K). Racing is up 1.60x (WRONG WAY! 9.0K) and linear courses 1.47x. Low poly art is up 1.56x.
ideas.differentiator: Rock games have you push or lift one rock; here the rock is your race car and it grows mid-race.

ideas.title: Drill Safes for Cash
ideas.hook: A bank tower full of locked safes. Drill them open floor by floor, keep the cash, and build your own vault to store it.
core_loop: Drill a safe on your floor
Collect the cash and loot inside
Upgrade your drill and your vault
Take the elevator to richer floors
ideas.twist: Top floors hold gold safes that take teamwork to crack, so players group up for the biggest payouts.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is up 3.17x (Break and Steal an Egg 184.1K CCU, My Anime Mine 11.4K) and Money / rich is up 1.99x (Paint to Get Rich 22.3K, Climb For Animals Eggs 42.2K). Interior maps are up 1.94x and realistic art 1.70x.
ideas.differentiator: Mine games are rocks and caves; this is a building of safes where each floor pays more.

ideas.title: Grow Gowns for Fame
ideas.hook: Plant fabric seeds in your garden and grow full gowns on the vines. Wear the best ones on stage to earn fame.
core_loop: Plant a fabric seed
Water it until the gown blooms
Harvest and wear it on the catwalk
Spend fame on rarer seeds
ideas.twist: Planting two seeds side by side can cross-breed a new pattern, so gardens become design labs.
ideas.why_now: Fashion / beauty is up 1.57x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 17.9K CCU, Makeup Mania 4.5K) and Dress Up is up 1.47x. Grow / farm is up 1.37x (Prehistoric Farm 5.3K, Build a Base & Steal Plants 5.0K).
ideas.differentiator: Dress-up games give you a closet; here you farm the clothes and cross-breed new looks.

ideas.title: Shop vs Shop
ideas.hook: Two players run rival shops across the street, fighting for the same customers. Steal footfall with deals, signs and sabotage.
core_loop: Stock your shop
Set prices and put up signs
Pull customers away from your rival
Win the round and spend profit on upgrades
ideas.twist: Each round the street rolls a random trend (fries day, toy day), so you restock fast to win it.
ideas.why_now: "___ vs ___" titles are up 1.29x (Bunker vs Verity 26.1K CCU). Sell / run a shop is up 1.51x (Sell Fries! 48.6K) and Money / rich 1.99x. Tycoon / base building is up 1.93x.
ideas.differentiator: Shop sims are solo; here the rival is a real player across the street.
